proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6327 *diddā explicitly lists Kumaoni didī, Nepali didi, Bengali/Oriya didi and Hindi dīdī “elder sister”. The nursery/kinship formation is identified without claiming a secure deeper root; extended -iyā and transmission outside the cited area require review.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10104 māsa explicitly gives Khowar mas “moon, month”, Torwali mah “month”, Lahnda māh and widespread eastern mās “month”. The semantic distinction in each survey is preserved; this is not the homophonous flesh word, and bare mā/mõ contractions are excluded without a local paradigm.
